# Fill My Bracket: full page text

> Complete text of fillmybracket.com: the homepage, privacy, and terms.
> Fill My Bracket will fill a full March Madness bracket from five questions, with zero
> basketball knowledge required. It is coming in March 2027. Free forever, no ads, no accounts.
> Text captured from the live pages, 2026-10-31.

## Homepage (https://fillmybracket.com/)

Coming March 2027
Fill My Bracket
You answer five questions. We fill your March Madness bracket.
Free forever. No ads. No accounts. It takes about two minutes.
The field will be set on Sunday, March 14, 2027.
Share
We pick all 63 games for you. One champion at the end.
Your bracket, as a poster
Fill My Bracket
Champion: your pick here
Print it. Pin it up. Every game, round by round.
How it will work
1. Answer five questions
Safe picks or big upsets. Mascots or team colors.
2. Get one full 63-game bracket
Every game picked, round by round, champion included. Print it or share it with friends.
3. No basketball knowledge needed
Your answers do the picking, each with a one-line reason.
Common questions
Do I need to know basketball?
No. Answer five simple questions about what you like. Your answers pick each game. No basketball knowledge needed.
When can I fill my bracket?
Teams are announced on Selection Sunday, March 14, 2027. Come back that evening. Fill it before first games start.
Is it free?
Yes. Fill My Bracket is free forever. No ads. No accounts.
What is a seed?
A seed is a team's regional rank. Seed 1 is strongest. Seed 16 is weakest. First games pair high against low.
What we don't do
We don't fill brackets yet. The picker opens on Selection Sunday, March 14, 2027.
We don't host pools, take entries, or handle prize money. You print or share your bracket and run your own pool.
We don't pick from expert rankings or team stats. Your five answers do the picking.
Our guarantees
Free forever.
No ads. No accounts.
No email needed. There is no signup on this page.
Built with Muse.
Privacy Terms
More family tools: ThawDay, the turkey timeline

## Privacy (https://fillmybracket.com/privacy)

Privacy
Privacy, in plain words
Fill My Bracket is a free coming-soon page.
This page has no forms and no sign-ups. Nothing here asks for your name or email.
This page loads Cloudflare Web Analytics. It counts visits to this site.
The home page also runs PostHog. PostHog counts page views there.
It counts taps on the Share button, share arrivals, and return visits. It does not record your screen.
The home page saves one small note. The note says you came here before. It holds no name or email.
The full bracket tool is not built yet. We will update this page before it launches.
Questions about this page: hello@fillmybracket.com.
Built with Muse.
Home Terms

## Terms (https://fillmybracket.com/terms)

Terms
Terms, in plain words
Fill My Bracket is a free coming-soon page.
The full bracket tool is not built yet. It opens in March 2027.
This page is free to read. There are no accounts and no sign-ups.
Nothing here is betting advice. The tool will make fun picks only.
Come back on Selection Sunday, March 14, 2027. The real tool opens then.
We may update these terms. The new version will live on this page.
Questions about this page: hello@fillmybracket.com.
